subject.title: feat(talk): expose gateway audio to plugins

question: Should installed native plugins be permitted to subscribe to raw PCM from arbitrary Gateway Talk sessions through the permanent `scope: "all"` runtime API, and should Gateway-owned consultation become a supported Talk ownership mode?
rationale: The patch is intentionally adding a public API and a sensitive-data access model, not repairing an established contract; source review cannot choose the repository’s plugin trust and compatibility policy.

options.title: Approve trusted-native model
options.body: Accept whole-Gateway raw-media observation as a documented capability for installed native plugins and review the API as a stable plugin-runtime contract.

options.title: Require scoped capability
options.body: Require a plugin capability or owner authorization before allowing cross-session or all-session PCM observation, then add focused contract tests for denial and authorized delivery.

options.title: Narrow the proposal
options.body: Keep only session-specific integration after confirming a supported caller can safely obtain the session identity, and defer Gateway-owned consultation separately.

recommendation.title: Approve trusted-native model
recommendation.body: Accept whole-Gateway raw-media observation as a documented capability for installed native plugins and review the API as a stable plugin-runtime contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the proposed media and consult-ownership design and can clarify the intended native-plugin and avatar integration contract.
